{{Quote|Have you ever heard of Arnot Station?''"<br />"''No. What is it?|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="RE">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>}}
'''Arnot Station''' was a commercial [[Space station/Legends|space platform]] frequented by [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] operating small and medium [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]], along with some local shipping lines, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
